summary: Full e2e validation of the 'Mi tarjeta' card configurator feature (backend + frontend). All 10 new card-config backend tests pass; all 26 existing GeoPass regression tests still pass. Frontend e2e verified: sidebar nav, route, live preview, template switching with correct value/label pairs, color/radius/text inputs, save+toast, persistence after reload, QR section with correct slug URL, mobile layout. No regressions on Dashboard/Socios/Notificaciones/Configuración. Restored tenant config to defaults at end of test.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: TenantCardConfig.plantilla_fidelizacion has no Pydantic enum/Literal validator — only checked at runtime in update_card_config. Consider using Literal['puntos','sellos','niveles','descuento'] in the model for OpenAPI clarity (low priority, currently returns 400 correctly).

ConfiguracionTarjeta.jsx: input maxLength={40} on nombre_programa but backend allows 60. Front/back diverge — frontend caps at 40 while backend accepts up to 60. Recommend aligning to 60 on the input or to 40 on the backend model.

ConfiguracionTarjeta.jsx: logo accepted as base64 data URL (≤500 KB) and stored in tenants.logo_url as a giant TEXT. Acceptable for MVP but should migrate to Supabase Storage to keep DB rows small and pass payloads light.

server.py L407-432: _trigger_railway_template_update uses sync httpx.Client inside the request thread — adds up to 10s to the PATCH response if Railway is slow. Recommend running it as a background task (BackgroundTasks or asyncio.create_task) since it's intentionally best-effort.
server.py file is 1329 lines — exceeds 700-line guideline; consider splitting into routers (auth, tenant, socios, notifications, public, superadmin).
seed_data_creation: No new seed data. Test PATCH-ed the umania-demo tenant config to verify persistence, then restored it to defaults (nombre_programa='Club de socios', colors #00E5A0/#0EA5E9, mensaje_geopush='', radio=150, plantilla=puntos).
context_for_next_testing_agent: card-config endpoints verified at /api/tenant/card-config (GET+PATCH). Auth via Supabase JWT bearer. 7 PATCH fields: nombre_programa, color_primario, color_secundario, logo_url, mensaje_geopush (max 60), radio_geopush (50-500), plantilla_fidelizacion (puntos|sellos|niveles|descuento). _build_pass_payload now includes all branding/template fields. Frontend page at /configuracion-tarjeta uses data-testids: pass-preview, input-nombre-programa, color-primario-{swatch,picker,hex}, color-secundario-*, input-mensaje-geopush, slider-radio-geopush, radio-value, template-{puntos,sellos,niveles,descuento}, btn-save-card, qr-canvas-wrapper, qr-url, btn-download-qr, btn-copy-link, preview-template-label, preview-value, nav-mi-tarjeta. Railway /passes/update-template returns 404 — expected (best-effort).
